messages:
Mira: Flagging audio echo from the remote panelist joining over Zoom. We're hearing a loop every ~7s. Can streaming team mute the Zoom return and route the mix through the NDI bridge?
Ethan: I'm on it. Muting Zoom return now and creating an NDI sender for the remote feed. This should remove the loop but expect a 2-3s audio offset while we switch.
Priya: Hosts, please hold audience mics while we flip to avoid battle-of-the-mics. We'll announce when it's safe to resume.
Jules: If we do the NDI bridge, can we also lock the iso recorder so editors know where the cut happens?
Ethan: Yes. Commands I used:
```
# mute zoom return
zoomctl set-ret-audio off
# enable ndi sender
ndictl create-sender remote_panel_stage2
# lock iso recorder
recctl lock /recordings/allhands/iso_stage2
```
Ethan: NDI sender live, Zoom return muted. Please confirm no more echo on your end.
Mira: Echo gone for me. Thanks. There's a small lip-sync shift though; captions might be out by ~1.5s.
Priya: I'll pause caption ingestion briefly and resume after sync.
Olivia (CEO): Quick coordination question: can we move the leadership Q&A to after the remote panel closes? I want to avoid juggling speakers during the fix.
Mira: Makes sense. We'll move leadership Q&A to the end of the panel segment and announce the reorder.
Jules: I'll annotate the op notes with the exact cut time for editors and mark ISO lock points. Path: /recordings/allhands/iso_stage2.locked
ndi-bot: [automated] NDI sender created: remote_panel_stage2, latency_est=2.1s
stream-bot: [automated] Stream health: viewers=980, cpu=59%, current_latency=2.3s
Priya: Captions resumed. Running a quick resync using the NDI audio reference track. If editors need it later, iso path is /recordings/iso/ndi_remote.wav
Mira: Hosts notified on stage and overlay updated: "Leadership Q&A moved to post-panel due to live audio routing fix".
Olivia (CEO): Fine with that. Please keep one pre-submitted roadmap question reserved for me during the final Q&A slot.
Ethan: Leaving a note for post: merge iso segments and run a 1.5s caption shift where needed. I'll drop the exact timestamp in the postmortem.
Mira: Great. I'll post a short incident note in #all-hands after wrap with timestamps, the ndi sender id, and the recorder paths. Thanks team for the fast swap. :thumbsup:
